description.narrative:
As the Secretary-General noted on 18 May 2016, Asia is continuing its rise while facing challenges that endanger its prosperity and stability. Political and historical tensions, including territorial disputes, within Northeast Asia contribute to these challenges and impede international cooperation. The Korean Peninsula remains the key peace and security issue in the region, with the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea’s (DPRK) increasing isolation leaving little room for compromise or hope for progress. The Secretary-General has expressed his commitment to supporting initiatives that build mutual confidence for peace and security in Northeast Asia. He has counseled countries in the region to engage in dialogue, expand productive cooperation, and move towards mutual trust and full reconciliation, welcoming efforts to facilitate peaceful and comprehensive solutions through dialogue. 

This programme is in response to the limited opportunities for dialogue with Northeast Asia; the limited UN resources and space for engagement on Korean Peninsula issues; and the need to overcome the difficulties related to including DPRK representatives in key forums for engagement. The overarching goal of this programme is to promote peace and stability in Northeast Asia. Establishing consistent channels of dialogue, cooperation and diplomacy at all levels presents an opportunity to contribute to ending the cycle of provocations, establish common ground, build trust, and support a return to dialogue.

UNOPS provides holistic project management and operational support including: financial, personnel and procurement services that improve our partners’ ability to deliver successful projects.
